title: Inertia and Entropy
coreMove: Treat resistance and drift as structural facts to diagnose and counter, not moral failures to scold.
sourcePressure: Organizations resist change and decay for structural reasons; inertia is built-in drag and entropy is loss of coherence over time. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Inertia and entropy mean people do not care enough.
